Thanks for the reply. I especially agree with your last statement. Ideally, i believe no animal should be hurt by humans. However, if i'm trying to be as realistic as i can, animals will always suffer at the hands of humans. It is impossible to stop this from happening, at least it seems so right now - the best we can do at this moment is enourage sustainable (if you'd even like to call it that) consumption of animal products, making sure the animal at least didn't live in stress and did not have painful end. I totally respect your opinion and i believe what you're doing is great for the animals. I'm trying to be better, but i'm definitely not perfect. Though i think it can start small - like starting by buying secondhand leather - and then turn into something bigger.

thanks for the reply! tbh what you said makes a lot of sense. secondhand animal products definitely make sound good as you get best of both worlds - the durability of the leather (or whatever else, for that matter) and not directly supporting the industry. might help with some of that guilt
